custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order A, with one line for another part, not yet received.
  • Start on purchase order A (Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then purchase order A).

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  3. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  4. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425727- and the descriptions start ZZAUTOTEST PL C425727 PART.
  5. Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO; pick any Vendor, type any existing part number in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then Save & Close. A purchase order made this way has no work order, so its page shows the Add Order Item button.
